quotes.text: We keep the compose window open so the recovery dialog can be shown

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Send progress may stop before the send promise resolves. Keep the compose window open until progress stops so a failed copy to the Sent folder can show the Save Message recovery prompt. The browser test forces that failure.
title: Keep compose open through an asynchronous Sent-copy failure
